convergenceSignals.note: This is a strong first iteration: REQ-101 through REQ-114's own zero-content-change claim is independently confirmed via a live git diff (not trusted from the manifest), the 19-obligation issuance/servicing re-partition is independently confirmed lossless via manual set comparison, the two-orchestrator design split is genuinely sound (no lock-scope confusion found), and the contract's own schema/parsing is independently confirmed correct via live invocation of the real parser and the real validateApprovedSprintContract function (not merely trusted). The single finding, FIND-S2-001, is a real but narrow completeness gap: REQ-115 explicitly forecloses the pinned-input-derivation defect class for its own lenderId/borrowerId parameters, but REQ-116 (added in the SAME commit, by the SAME author, immediately following REQ-115) omits the equivalent statement for its own loanId/txHash parameters -- an asymmetry between two sibling requirements that both this manifest and this session's own prior review history explicitly flag as a recurring risk class worth catching early, before it becomes load-bearing at Phase 2a/3. This is a single-location-per-file fix (one new Edge Case bullet in behavioral-spec.md, one small PROP/Gate addition in verification-architecture.md, no change needed to contracts/sprint-2.md's own scored criteria unless the fix author chooses to add an 8th CRIT) and should converge in iteration 2 without further design rework. Route to Phase 1a.
